note: Images wanted by a look or build. Builders draw stand-ins and list requests here; nothing is generated until the look is picked and the owner says yes. Prompts describe the picture, never the production (no 'asset', 'deliverable' or 'module'), and end with the exclusions. Set picked to the chosen file's path under media/generated/ once the owner picks. A clip adds "kind": "video".

requests.prompt: Soft, out-of-focus kitchen counter surface in warm morning light, pale wood grain, shallow depth of field. No text, no people, no logos, no objects.
requests.where: Background layer behind scene 1 (#scene-1), under the counter bar.
requests.stand_in: flat gradient from the ground colour to 6% darker
